evals.prompt: Fact-check: As of today, Acme is Europe's largest private AI company, has 12,000 employees, and became profitable in 2024.
evals.expected_output: Splits and verifies each current claim independently.

evals.prompt: Three articles say the mayor resigned May 4; the city clerk's dated record says May 6. Verify the date.
evals.expected_output: Traces source lineage and date semantics.

evals.prompt: Our CRM says Ava founded Northstar in 2021 because Ava appears on the account and launch notes. Fact-check it.
evals.expected_output: Separates CRM fidelity from external truth.

evals.prompt: Fact-check: A 2025 study proved that the supplement prevents dementia by 40 percent.
evals.expected_output: Verifies study design, effect, and causal wording.

evals.prompt: Audit this draft only. Do not edit it. Wikipedia and the company's press release agree that its product is clinically proven.
evals.expected_output: Returns proposed corrections without editing and uses claim-relative research evidence.
assertions: Original clinical evidence and corrections checked

evals.prompt: Five outlets repeat the same wire story saying the policy started today; the official text has an effective date next month.
evals.expected_output: Counts the derivative reports as one chain and uses the official effective date for the legal claim.
assertions: Publication date separated from effective date
